L.wiring_rule: the real wiring and E133's within-type claw permutations of seeds 1 to 3

R.wiring_rule: the real wiring and E133's within-type claw permutations of seeds 1 to 3

family.label: the calyx's family (E130's fit; olfsysm's pn_inhadd 31.4)

F.label: pn_inhadd 1000 with pn_inhsc by E77's rule

D1.8.label: B with the calyx's matrix at x1.8 of its fitted scale

A1.label: B with the calyx's matrix at x3.24 of its fitted scale

D5.8.label: B with the calyx's matrix at x5.83 of its fitted scale

Dabs.label: B with L's matrix at the absolute scale A1 reaches on the hemibrain's real wiring

operating_points.apl16: the calyx's fit's two response counts
operating_points.apl_off: APL on times the calyx's fit's APL-off / APL-on response counts

definitions.bar: A calyx's bar is twice the standard error of a change over its four wirings.
definitions.spreads: The hemibrain family's over its eight wirings (E136's), the yardstick of every class so far; the calyx's own SD over four wirings beside.

classes.e136: E136's classes with E139's price, on L's and R's four wirings (each setting against the calyx's own family on the same wiring; megamat against the held-out half, all flies beside).
classes.a1_replicates: A1 replicates on a calyx: A1 holds there.
classes.rise_needed: The rise is needed there: B does not hold, and D1.8, A1 or D5.8 does.
classes.family_inside: The calyx's family is inside the hemibrain's wirings: the family's strength error on the calyx's real wiring is inside the range of the hemibrain family's eight wirings, at the boutons, the claws and the somata.
classes.claw_default: The claw default changes it: on H, a megamat stage or a held-out panel of a setting differs from the 'first' real wiring's by more than its spread; the classes are then read against H.
classes.dose_ladder: A description: validation2's change along B, D1.8, A1 and D5.8 on the real wiring, beside the hemibrain's (+0.080, +0.021, -0.016, -0.036).
classes.no_class: No class for a wiring outside a realism band or whose holds fail. The number of calyces and settings tried is reported with any that holds. No calyx, dose or setting becomes a base without Tom's or Yang's word.

outcomes.a: A1 replicates on both male calyces (about 1 in 5): the hold is not one fly's; A1, with E141's doses, goes to Tom and Yang as a candidate base read on three calyces.
outcomes.b: Megamat falls on both and A1 holds on neither (about 1 in 4): the rise keeps the held-out panels only with the hemibrain's matrix; step 0's table says what that matrix has that the male ones lack, and a planner weighs moving it between calyces (E133's arms) under the stage target.
outcomes.c: It replicates on one calyx (about 1 in 3): the two male calyces differ in APL's synapses at the boutons and in their fitted KC-KC scale (7.7 and 25.8); step 2 reads the doses on the other's permutations.
outcomes.d: B holds on a male calyx without the rise (about 1 in 8): the need for the rise is the hemibrain's, and so is E141's question of what carries it.
outcomes.e: A male calyx's family is outside the hemibrain's wirings at a megamat stage (about 1 in 2 at the boutons; beside any of the above): the stage table on the male CNS goes to Tom, whose shared models are built on it.
outcomes.f: The claw default changes a class on the hemibrain (about 1 in 5): the male calyces are then read against H, not against the eight wirings, and the note says so.

L.would_fail_it: the APL16 somata with APL on; its low KC-KC scale (7.7 against 26.4)

judgments: The start of every hold is the calyx's fit's absolute parameters (E130's counted fit, its fits.csv row) with the setting's factors; the threshold (APL off) and the APL->KC scale with KC->APL and bouton->APL tied (APL on) are then held exactly (E77's hold_rates, E136's APL bracket 0.1 to 10). E136's reads start from the family's held megamat point, which the male calyces do not have.
A permutation (E133's within-type claw permutation of seed 1, 2 or 3) runs at its calyx's fit's scales and operating points (the same KCs, so the same counts on the APL16 input).

The breadth behind the APL->KC weights is the calyx wiring's APL-off breadth on the lab's APL16 input (E133's calyx_tables; recomputed on a permutation), on every panel and setting, as E136's and E139's reads hold it.
RISE and APLPN are E141's rounded x3.24 and x0.155 (E139's K and B). Dabs is RISE times the family's KC-KC scale on the hemibrain's real wiring (E83's saved_fit('real'), 26.43): 85.6.
F's and B's normalization is E141's pn_terms (pn_inhadd 1000, pn_inhsc by E77's inhsc_for), E139's rung 1000.
A read's tag is '<calyx>_<setting>_<panel>_<wiring>'; a megamat read's row has half 'held' (the score reads it against the held-out half, all flies beside), the others none.
The stage readings' seed index of a wiring is its position in (real, P1, P2, P3), so that H's real wiring is pooled and noised as the family's real wiring (E136's seed_index 0).
The KC-KC matrix of a male calyx is E130's (Pratyush's KCclaw-to-KCclaw table, matrices.json's sha256); H's is olfsysm's hemibrain matrix among H's KCs ('argmax' claws), as E130's refit has it.

amendments.what: Design item 4's "E143's intervals over flies on every change, if they are in" made concrete (they are in: E143 completed 2026-11-26 11:34). Every read is read once against all the flies of each stage and panel, as E143 reads saved runs (E143's read_runs: E134's default readings with the curve, noise and criterion of all the stage's flies, this experiment's seed index), into outputs/E144_a1_malecns_calyces/views/. E143's 1,000 resamples of the flies (its resamples: seed 0, N_BOOT 1000, each megamat stage and each held-out panel drawn with replacement from one generator, so that megamat's four stages are resampled together; the flies of E143's lock) are the references, in all the flies' one-fly units, the unresampled flies last. For every change in classes.json's class tables (each setting against its calyx's family on the wirings it was read on): its 5th to 95th percentile over the resamples (E143's CI), the share of resamples better than the bar and worse than the spread; each class recomputed on every resample (E143's reclass: E136's ladder with the spreads, bars and the reasons that do not depend on the flies as scored) and the share of resamples that give the scored class; the derived classes (A1 replicates, the rise is needed, B holds, megamat falls with A1) and the outcomes (a) to (d) recomputed the same way. E143's joint splits are not read, so its "a change stands" is given for the held-out panels only (the interval excluding zero); 'stands' is None on megamat's rows. Tables: e143_intervals_changes.csv, e143_class_shares.csv, e143_intervals.json (experiments/E144_score.py's part_resampled).
amendments.why: The entry's design item 4 names E143's intervals beside the score; E143's note found that A1's "holds" on the hemibrain stands on 54 % of its resamples, so a class on a male calyx is read with its share.
